title: DevIDE preview-ui-walk manifest
description: App-owned contract for a UI smoke walk (.devide/preview-walk.json). DevIDE ships drivers + this schema; product repos own instances. Browser baseline: path/lands_on/budget/console/network/screenshot. Runtime (Tidewave): logs, project_eval probes, SELECT-only SQL, LiveView assign keys. Optional pages[].steps for assertions and (gated) interactions. Drivers skip runtime when Tidewave is unavailable and MUST mark that skip explicitly.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema (or a copy) for editor validation.

version.description: Schema version. Omit or set 1 for this revision.

pages.description: Screens to visit in order. Derive from the app router, not guesses.

strict_errors.description: When true, any raw console/network error fails the page (disables CSP noise filter).

noise_patterns.description: Extra case-insensitive regex sources treated as noise (merged with driver defaults).

workspace.description: OPTIONAL host hint: DevIDE agent-mcp env dir name (~/.devide/agent-mcp/<workspace>/env.sh). Prefer resolving workspace from launch env; product manifests should omit this when possible.

app_surface.description: OPTIONAL host hint for preview MCP walk.py (preview_surfaces name). Not used by playwright_walk.mjs.

_driver.description: Human annotation for which driver to prefer; ignored by drivers (login.kind/type selects the path).

kind.description: Preferred product-facing auth model. Skill maps: redirect_cookie → playwright_walk.mjs; session → walk.py session inject; click → UI login; none → public pages.

type.description: Legacy driver field. cookie ≡ redirect_cookie; session_inject ≡ session. Prefer kind; drivers accept either.

params.description: Query/body params for the login route. Avoid hardcoding operator identity long-term; prefer env overrides at run time.

params_from_env.description: Env var names whose values are merged into login.params at run time (e.g. WALK_LOGIN_EMAIL).

lands_on.description: Expected post-login path prefix. Bounce to /login must fail the walk.

name.description: Stable label used in the report and as key for runtime.per_page.

lands_on.description: Expected landed path (defaults to path). Anti false-green for auth redirects.

role_gated.description: Annotation only: page requires elevated role.

note.description: Annotation only: why this page is in the walk.

runtime.description: Optional per-page Tidewave/SQL probes (merged over runtime.per_page[name]).

steps.description: Ordered interactions/assertions after navigate+settle. Read-only actions always run; click/fill/type/press require safety.allow_interactions and non-prod env_check.

action.description: Step kind. assert_*/wait_for/settle are always allowed; click/fill/type/press/select/check/uncheck/hover are mutating.

text.description: Text to assert, fill, or type.

event.description: Optional phx-click / event name for deny_events matching.

required.description: When false, a blocked mutating step is SKIPPED instead of FAIL.

continue_on_fail.description: When true, keep running remaining steps after a failure.

safety.description: Agent/operator policy. Default is read-only navigate+screenshot. Mutating pages[].steps require allow_interactions:true and a non-prod env_check strip.

read_only.description: When true (default), mutating steps are blocked unless allow_interactions is also true. Prefer keeping this true and only opting interactions in deliberately.

allow_interactions.description: Opt-in for pages[].steps that click/fill/type/press. Still blocked when env_check finds prod_like values, and still respects deny_events.

env_check.description: Env keys whose values should be inspected for prod write risk (e.g. APP_API_URL). Report surfaces results; mutating steps fail closed if any are prod_like.

deny_events.description: phx-click / event names the walk must never fire (matched against step.event).

runtime.description: Server-side evidence via Tidewave (and optional SQL). When Tidewave is unreachable, the walk still runs; runtime evidence MUST be reported as skipped: tidewave_unavailable.

tidewave.description: When true, collect Tidewave evidence (logs + optional probes). Dev/preview-env only — never prod.

log_levels.description: Server log levels to pull after each page (priority: error, then warning).

probes.description: Allowlisted project_eval checks (walk-level). No free-form eval during a smoke walk.

liveview.description: Default LiveView state capture policy for every page when Tidewave is on.

per_page.description: Map of page name → extra probes/SQL/LiveView for that screen.

require_tidewave.description: When true, fail the whole walk if Tidewave is unavailable (default: skip runtime evidence).

sql.description: SELECT-only probe. Drivers must reject non-SELECT and cap rows.

expect_min.description: Minimum numeric result for sql (e.g. count(*)).

expect.description: Exact expected value for a single-cell sql or probe result.

name.description: Stable probe id in the report (e.g. superadmin_role).

eval.description: Small Elixir expression for Tidewave project_eval. Keep pure/read-only; no mutations.

expect.description: If set, probe PASS requires stringified result equality (or boolean/number match).

liveview_probe.description: Capture LiveView process evidence without dumping PII-heavy full assigns into the artifact.

assign_keys.description: Record assign key names only (not values) for hydration proof.

fields.description: Optional small derived facts (e.g. current_user.role) — keep non-PII.

baseline.description: Reserved for visual-diff against a prior run (not wired in v1 drivers).
